$comment: What counts as a symbol and as an import in JSON Schema, the dialect of JSON whose files hold the value of `dialect` below as the `$schema` of their top-level object. A symbol is a definition under the `$defs` of the top-level object, and its SpecTags are whole lines of the string in its `$comment`. The SpecTags of the code outside every definition are whole lines of the `$comment` of the top-level object. `$schema` is the file's import. JSON Schema has no tests.
